slot_scores.name: mandatory_bob_selection
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Are there any other eligibility rules for which children can be selected? ... At least one specific child must be included in the trip. / Which specific child must be included in the trip? ... Bob must be included.
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked whether a specific child must be included and then identified Bob as mandatory.

slot_scores.name: alice_diana_conflict_rule
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked about mutual exclusion or conflict constraints involving Alice and Diana, nor marked this as an assumption needing confirmation.

slot_scores.name: minimize_total_cost_objective
slot_scores.evidence_quote: What should the trip selection optimize? ... Minimize the total cost of the selected children.
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked about the objective and confirmed minimizing total cost.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: There is no Alice-Diana conflict rule; Alice and Diana may be selected together unless otherwise constrained.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about or confirmed any mutual exclusion between Alice and Diana, but proceeded to model without this hidden constraint.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent entered READY_TO_MODEL while the P1 Alice-Diana conflict rule remained unresolved.

summary: The agent recovered the objective and mandatory Bob selection, but missed the Alice-Diana conflict rule and stopped with that P1 hidden slot unresolved.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
